svg.aria-label: hello, i'm sohane, a developer. i enjoy typescript, c and react and lately rust. i'm also addicted to typing.. like, really fast typing. i open monkeytype every single day, right now i'm stuck at 130 wpm. one more test. then another one. the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. my hands know this keyboard better than they know my own handwriting. code, words, ideas, all the same: get them out before they fade. some days the wall moves a little. most days it doesn't. i'll be back tomorrow anyway.
